translation.name: An it jilchith cau cʼal i Ajatic Jesucristo

book.name: SAN JUAN
book.title: An alhua’ cau thuchath c’al an t’ocat inic Juan

content: An ajib tin cuenta an tomquintalab ti bichou Caná axi cuentalith Galilea
Ne’ets quin t’aja’ ox a q’uicha tam ti caunenec a Natanael c’al a Jesús, ani exom i ajib tin cuenta i tomquintalab ti bichou Caná axi cuentalith Galilea. Tats ti c’uajat in mim a Jesús c’al an ajib.
C’uajatchic taja’ jaye a Jesús ani huahua’ tu exobalilchic, cum u caniyame cu c’ale.
Ani cum talits an vino, uchan a Jesús c’al in mim: ―Yabats hua’ats i vino quin uts’a’chic.
Toc’tsin a Jesús: ―Ca aychi hue’, mim. U tso’ob jant’o ne’ets cu t’aja’ tam quim bajuhuits an hora cu t’aja’. In q’uibchale hue’ abal cu t’aja’.
Tam in mim a Jesús in ucha’ am buc’ulchic c’al an c’apnel ani c’al an uts’nel: ―Ca t’ajchichic patal jahua’ ne’ets ti ucha’ jaja’.

Hua’ats taja’ acac i pulic mul ax u balchixnab c’al an ja’ abal quin t’acaxna’ an Israelchic tam ne’ets ti c’ac’nax c’al a Dios. Ti junchic an mul in ac’nal jat’hua’ ti tse’ inicchic ani ti bo’ inic i litro i ja’.
A Jesús in ucha’chic am buc’ulchic c’al an c’apnel ani c’al an uts’nel: ―Ca t’uchiychic c’al i ja’ nix an mul. Ani in t’uchiychic ma eblim.
Tam a Jesús in ucha’chic: ―Ca caltha’ hue’ i ja’ ani ca nenchi tihua’ an cuentalom c’al an ajib. Tam in caltha’chic ani in nenchi jant’ini’ ti uchan c’al a Jesús.

An cuentalom im bats’u ani in leca’ an vino axi pelac i ja’. Yab in tso’ob ju’ta tin chi’tha’, expith in tso’obits ax in caltha’chic an ja’ quim bina’. Tam an cuentalom in caniy ca chich an tomiclab inic.

Ani in ucha’: ―Ets’ey in ujnam an inic quin oc’ox pitha’ axi lej huinat alhua’ an vino ca uts’an yan c’al an tamcunel ajibal, ani taley tiq’uele axi yab lej alhua’. Tata’ yab a t’ajamal antsana’. Hue’its ne’ets ca taley an ajib, ani ma xohue’ a pithal an vino axi lej huinat alhua’.

Antsana’ a Jesús tin huenc’ou an ja’ ti vino ti al an ajib tin cuenta an tomquintalab ti bichou Caná axi cuentalith Galilea. Ja’its an oc’ox labith t’ajbilab in t’aja’ ti tsu’bixtalab c’al in ey. Cum antsana’ in tejhua’metha’ in ey abal in lej cua’al in tsap, jaxtam huahua’ pel tu exobalilchic a Jesús i belamal.
Taley u c’ale huahua’ tu exobalil a Jesús junax c’al jaja’ ti bichou Capernaum, ani c’al in at ebchalchic, ani c’al in mim’ jaye. Ani tats tu jilc’onchic tsab ox a q’uicha.
A Jesús in quethmayal eleb i inicchic axi al am pulic tiyopan

Hue’its ne’ets quim baju an q’uicha tam an Israelchic quin t’aja’ an ajib tin cuenta abal ti calthame ti Egipto im biyal juntalchic. Cum ne’ets quin t’aja’chic ti bichou Jerusalén, tats ti c’ale tihua’ a Jesús.
Otsits al an tiyopan ani in tsu’u i nujul hueyax, ani i nujul oveja, ani i nujul lab cucu’. Hua’ats jaye al an tiyopan quetechic tin mexajil i jalum tuminchic.

Tam tin tsu’u a Jesús jahua’ in t’ajalchic, in ts’ejca’ jun i cuathaxtalab ts’aj abal quin quethmaychic. Taley in tala’ quethmachiquiyal eleb an nujulchic c’al patal an ovejachic ani an hueyaxchic. In cuajlachiquinchal in mexajil an jalum tuminchic, ani huac’lalal ti c’ale in tuminal.
Tam a Jesús in ucha’chic an nujul lab cucu’: ―Ca thubat caltha’ a nujnelil ani yabats ca eyentha’ ti nujumtalab in q’uima’ u Tata ti eb.

Tamits huahua’ tu exobalil i t’ila’ jahua’ thuchath tin T’ocat Thuchlab tin cuenta a Jesús antse’: Tu t’ayat ichich u lej cua’al u canat abal ca chubax eyentha in q’uima’ a Dios jant’ini’ in tomnal ca eyentha c’al axi lej chubax c’ac’nax c’al a Dios.
Tam conoyat a Jesús c’al talchic i Israelchic: ―¿Jant’o ne’ets ca t’aja’ ti tsu’bixtalab abal qui tso’obna’ max chubax a cua’al a uchbil ca tala’ quethmay i inicchic antsana’ eleb ti al an tiyopan?
Tam a Jesús in toc’tsiychic: ―Max tata’chic ca paclu axe’ xi tiyopan, nan ne’ets cu tsab ts’ejca’ junil ti ox a q’uicha.
Ani uchan a Jesús c’al jaja’chic: ―Auxe’ max ca chubax ejtou ca tsab ts’ejca’ ti ox a q’uicha, cum an ts’ejcomchic c’al axe’ xi tiyopan in t’ojna’ tsab inic c’al acac i tamub ti ts’ejcom.
Tam ti a Jesús in ulu antsana’ c’al an tiyopan, pel i t’ipchixtalab c’al in inictal.

Huahua’ tu exobalilchic yab i thubat ejtiy nix an cau jahua’ in ulu. Expith i ejtiyits talbel tam ti ejthachits a Jesús. I t’ila’chic tamna’ jahua’ in ulumalits abal ne’ets quin tsab ts’ejca’ junil an tiyopan ti ox a q’uicha. Ma tamna’its i lej belchits jahua’ antsana’ thuchath ti al an T’ocat Thuchlab in cahuintal a Dios ani jahua’ in ulumalits a Jesús.
A Jesús in exlanchal in ichich tim patal an inicchic

Exome an ajib ti bichou Jerusalén tin cuenta abal ti calthame ti Egipto im biyal juntalchic an Israel. Tats ti xe’ets a Jesús in t’ajalchic i labith t’ajbilab ti tsu’bixtalab c’al in ey, ani c’al yantalam i inicchic tu belnal tam ti tsu’tabits jahua’ in t’ajamal.
Cum a Jesús in tala’ exlanchal in ichich jaja’chic, yab in lej bela’ max pel i chubax belom.
Yab in yejenchal ca olchin in ey an inic, cum in tala’ exlanchalits jant’o tam tsalap in ne’thal tin ichich an inicchic.
